reason: Petiole length 0-2 mm, correctly limited to the upper leaves (whole = leaf, upper FLOPO_0991376); the lower and middle leaves have other values.
'Doubly serrulate' is a kind of serrulate, so serrulate leaf (margin shape) is true, though less specific than the flora.
Sepals oblong to elliptic; reading 'to' as a continuum between oblong and elliptic is right.

fix: Read hyphenated two-colour compounds ('brown-yellow') with the last word as the main colour, as config/botanical_colour_synonyms.tsv does for 'brown yellow' and 'brownish yellow' (both map to yellow). Do not reorder them into the ISCC-NBS name 'yellowish brown'.

fix: 'filament(s)' in a stamen context should map to PO filament, not be widened to the stamen.
reason: The 6-8 mm is the length of the filaments, not of the whole stamen. The anthers are measured separately.

target: position: proximal (part of the margin / proximal lobes)
fix: In 'margins: proximal X, distal Y' the position words split the margin. Keep 'proximal' as a position slot rather than giving the whole blade the value.
reason: Only the proximal margin is pinnatifid or sinuate; the distal margin is dentate or entire. Without the position, the statement is false for the blade as a whole.

target: sepal (PO_0009031), contained in calyx (PO_0009060); stage/sex: female flowers
fix: 'Calyx lobes', 'corolla lobes' and other lobes of flower parts must not fall back to leaf lamina lobe. Map them to the lobe of the named container (calyx lobe as sepal or a calyx-lobe class).
reason: The 3 lanceolate lobes belong to the calyx of the female flowers, not to a leaf blade.
In FNA Schoenoplectus 'blades 0-1' gives the number of blades (blade absent or one), so a count of 0-1 for leaf lamina fits.

target: position: lower leaves (FLOPO lower); first alternative 'ovate-orbicular', not 'orbicular'
fix: Keep 'lower' from 'lower leaf blades' as the whole/position slot. Also keep hyphenated shape compounds ('ovate-orbicular') whole instead of taking only the last word.
reason: The shapes are given for the lower leaf blades only (upper leaves differ in this species). Also, the first alternative is ovate-orbicular, not plain orbicular.
Petioles broadly dilated at the base and vaginate, so sheathing petiole is right.

fix: For counts of ray or disc flowers, the container is the head (capitulum), not a flower.
reason: The count 12-15 ray flowers is right, but the container slot says flower (PO_0009046). Ray flowers are counted per head.

target: gland (waxy gland) on leaf lamina; present vs absent
fix: In 'X glands small, ..., or absent', the thing present or absent is the gland, with the leaf as the whole. Do not put presence on the leaf. Also, 'small' is a size, not a presence value (here it was mapped to present, PATO_0000467).
reason: The flora says the waxy glands are present (small, in the vein axils) or absent, not that the leaf is.
'Racemes panicled' means the racemes are arranged in a panicle, so the inflorescence is a panicle (of racemes).

target: leaf lamina (PO_0020039) absent, whole: (lower/sheathing) leaves; bladeless leaves present, ca. 4
fix: 'Bladeless X', 'leafless X' and similar negate the named part (the blade) and keep X present. The scope of the negation is the blade, not the leaf.
reason: The plant has about 4 leaves without blades (sheaths). It does not lack leaves; it has a normal leaf blade too.

fix: In 'phyllary apex green', the colour belongs to the apex, a part of the phyllary. Keep the part noun (apex, base, margin) as the bearer or a position slot.
reason: Only the phyllary apex is green or purple-brown, not the whole phyllary. The colours themselves (green, brown for purple-brown) are right.
'Stemless' (acaulescent) is read as stem absent. The flora's hedge ('apparently', 'imperfectly known') is not captured but does not reverse the claim.
'Didymous' means of two equal lobes, so a bilobed stigma is right (and the stigma is 'cleft to 1/3').
Follicles not striate, so 'fruit striated' with negation is right.

target: state: female (pistillate) catkin; bearer better catkin inflorescence (PO_0030119)
fix: Keep sex words ('female', 'male', 'pistillate', 'staminate') before an inflorescence or flower as a state slot. Here they contrast directly with the male catkins (5-9 cm).
reason: 10-15 cm is the length of mature female catkins only. Without 'female' the statement is false, because the male catkins are 5-9 cm.
'Feuilles: nombreuses' means many leaves present.

target: lobe of keel crest (keel PO_0025327 as whole)
fix: Lobes counted inside a flower-part sentence (here the keel crest) must not default to leaf lamina lobe. Take the bearer from the nearest named part.
reason: The 2-4 lobes on each side belong to the 2-parted crest of the keel petal, not to a leaf.
Inflorescences 4-18-flowered: flower count per inflorescence.
All four alternatives are mapped; 'carmine' is a vivid red, as in the colour synonym table.
Leaf blades not lobed.

Interpetiolar stipules often have a few small lobes on each side: stipule lobed, often.
The involucral bracts are obtriangular. 'Bract' is true, though involucral bract (PO_0009045) would be more specific.
